title: How the World Cup ball has changed over 96 years
description: The World Cup has been held for 96 years. The sport of soccer has changed a lot over the last century, and so has the ball. Michael George reports.

title: New recommendations to prevent child drownings from American Academy of Pediatrics

title: Americans taking up the art of Ikebana, Japanese flower arrangement
